<script>
function b64dec(b64){var bin=atob(b64);var bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++){bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);}return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);}
var cssB64 = '';
var css = "<style>" + b64dec(cssB64) + "</style>";
var htmlPart = `<div id="chc-period-simple-block">

<div class="topbar">THE CONFIDENT HORMONE CLUB</div>

<div class="wrap">
  <div class="eyebrow">Period Literacy & Faith Workshop</div>
  <h1>Understand your cycle. Decode your symptoms. Know what deserves a closer look.</h1>
  <div class="subtitle">What Your Period Is Trying to Tell You</div>
  <p class="desc">A live 2-hour workshop for Christian women who want to stop guessing what their body is telling them.</p>
  <ul class="benefits">
    <li><div class="check">&#10003;</div>Understand how your cycle actually works &mdash; and what your symptoms may mean.</li>
    <li><div class="check">&#10003;</div>Walk away with a framework for what to track, ask and investigate next.</li>
    <li><div class="check">&#10003;</div>Learn how faith and physical health work together, not against each other.</li>
  </ul>
  <div class="meta-line">LIVE ON ZOOM &middot; SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 26 &middot; 9:00&ndash;11:00 AM ET &middot; RECORDING + WORKBOOK INCLUDED</div>
  <div class="hero-img"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KeekstheKat/brandphotos/main/Happy%20Joy%20Woman.jpeg" alt="Period Literacy Workshop"><div class="tag">&#10024; Come as you are</div></div>
  <div class="teacher">
    <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KeekstheKat/brandphotos/main/_CAM0055.jpg" alt="Dr. Kaylee Alton">
    <div class="txt">Taught live by <b>Dr. Kaylee Alton, ND</b> &mdash; 12+ years helping women understand their hormones. Dr. Kaylee has a personal relationship with Jesus. Learn how health and faith intersect and practical tips you can do to support your period symptoms.</div>
  </div>
  <a href="#chc-checkout-anchor" class="btn chc-scroll-btn">Reserve Your Seat &rarr;</a>
</div>

<div class="below">
  <h3>What you'll walk away with</h3>
  <div class="cols2">
    <div class="col">
      <ul class="walk-list">
        <li>A clear picture of how your cycle works and what's worth tracking.</li>
        <li>A better sense of what PMS, pain, bleeding, fatigue, acne or PMOS/PCOS may be telling you.</li>
        <li>Language and questions to bring to your next doctor's appointment.</li>
        <li>A framework for your health, physically and spiritually.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="col faq-mini">
      <h4>Is this a Christian workshop?</h4>
      <p>Yes &mdash; practical period-health education, with faith intentionally part of the conversation.</p>
      <h4>Will there be a recording?</h4>
      <p>Yes &mdash; plus a downloadable workbook/guide, both included with your seat.</p>
      <h4>Refund policy?</h4>
      <p>All sales final &mdash; but your seat includes the recording and workbook, so it won't go to waste.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

</div>
`;
var footerHtml = `<div class="chc-period-simple-foot-wrap">
<div id="chc-period-simple-block">
  <div class="final-cta">
    <h4>Saturday, September 26 &middot; 9:00&ndash;11:00 AM ET &middot; Live on Zoom</h4>
    <p>Your seat includes the recording and workbook, either way.</p>
  </div>
  <footer>THE CONFIDENT HORMONE CLUB &middot; PERIOD LITERACY &amp; FAITH WORKSHOP</footer>
</div>
</div>
`;
var topHtml = css + htmlPart;

function hideAmex(){
  var imgs = document.querySelectorAll('.thrivecart-site img, .thrivecart-site svg');
  for (var i=0;i<imgs.length;i++){
    var alt = (imgs[i].getAttribute('alt')||'') + ' ' + (imgs[i].getAttribute('src')||'') + ' ' + (imgs[i].className||'');
    if (alt.toLowerCase().indexOf('amex') !== -1 || alt.toLowerCase().indexOf('american-express') !== -1 || alt.toLowerCase().indexOf('americanexpress') !== -1){
      imgs[i].style.display = 'none';
    }
  }
}

function hideCoupon(){
  var labels = document.querySelectorAll('.thrivecart-site label, .thrivecart-site .checkbox');
  for (var i=0;i<labels.length;i++){
    var t = (labels[i].textContent||'').trim();
    if (t.indexOf('Have a coupon code') !== -1){
      var container = labels[i].parentElement;
      if (container) { container.style.display = 'none'; }
      var next = container ? container.nextElementSibling : null;
      if (next && next.querySelector && next.querySelector('input')) { next.style.display = 'none'; }
    }
  }
  hideAmex();
}

function inject(){
  if(document.getElementById('chc-period-simple-block')) { hideCoupon(); return; }
  var site = document.querySelector('.thrivecart-site');
  var regions = document.querySelector('.builder-regions');
  if(!site || !regions) { return; }
  site.style.flexDirection = 'column';
  if(!regions.id) { regions.id = 'chc-checkout-anchor'; }
  var topWrap = document.createElement('div');
  topWrap.innerHTML = topHtml;
  site.insertBefore(topWrap, regions);
  var footWrap = document.createElement('div');
  footWrap.innerHTML = footerHtml;
  site.appendChild(footWrap);
  var btns = document.querySelectorAll('.chc-scroll-btn');
  for (var i=0;i<btns.length;i++){
    btns[i].addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      var target = document.getElementById('chc-checkout-anchor');
      if (target) { target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'}); }
    });
  }
  hideCoupon();
}
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', inject);
} else {
  inject();
}
setTimeout(inject, 400);
setTimeout(inject, 1200);
setTimeout(inject, 2500);
setTimeout(hideCoupon, 3500);

</script>
